sitat: After 36 months, employment incentive participants were 25.6 percentage points more likely to be in employment than their matched controls.

utfall: Sysselsetting på kort sikt 34 pp og lang sikt 23 pp, alle aldre (30 år og eldre), mot median i metaanalyser
sitat: The estimated short-term effect for Slovenia, 34 percentage points, is considerably higher than the median of 0 and 10 percentage points found in the 2018 and ESF meta-analyses, respectively.

sitat: Three years after beginning the programme, participants’ earnings amounted to EUR 21 086 more than their counterparts in the control group during the same period.
